minor.issue: No idempotency/guard: repeat accepts overwrite accepted_at silently (low impact).
3 tests self-skip on Resend 429 when the suite is run twice back-to-back (provider limit, not an app defect).

ui_bugs.issue: beforeprint handler only schedules a React state update; window.print() then renders synchronously, so the actual Chrome PDF can still capture the accordions collapsed (Radix unmounts closed AccordionContent, so print CSS alone cannot rescue it). Verified: dispatching beforeprint and reading the DOM in the SAME synchronous task yields 0 open items; only after a macrotask do 12 open nodes appear. Also native Ctrl+P will hit the same race.
Uses native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere.

integration_issues.issue: AuthContext calls /api/auth/me (+/auth/refresh) on the unauthenticated /share/:token route, producing 3x 401 console errors for guests. Cosmetic but noisy; skip the bootstrap on public routes.

rca_of_the_issue: window.print() dispatches 'beforeprint' synchronously and then blocks to lay out/print. The handler calls setOpenPolicies(...), a React state update that is flushed in a later task, so at print time the Radix AccordionContent for the 3 policies is still unmounted/closed. Playwright confirmation: page.evaluate dispatching beforeprint and counting open nodes in the same task returned 0; after a 600ms wait the count was 12 and '30% advance' was visible. Mitigation: expand state before invoking print (setTimeout/flushSync) and/or forceMount content plus print-media CSS overrides.
